export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/rossari-biotech-limited) shows 8,721 shipment records, 128 trading partners, 144 ports, latest cargo 2026-02-28. Exact rows seen (5 of 8,721): "2026-02-28 | ROSSARI BIOTECH LIMITED | TO ORDER | HAZIRA PORT SURAT INHZA1, India | Constanta, ROMANIA | 29094910 | BOL 1143561"; "2026-02-27 | ROSSARI BIOTECH LIMITED | TO ORDER | NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India | Bangkok, THAILAND | 34024900 | BOL 1104078"; "2026-02-26 | ROSSARI BIOTECH LIMITED | GREENWICH THERAPEUTICS LTD | SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4, India | ACCRA, Ghana | 34013019 | BOL 1034151"; "2026-02-25 | ROSSARI BIOTECH LIMITED | TO THE ORDER | HAZIRA PORT SURAT INHZA1, India | Laem Chabang, THAILAND | 28362090 | BOL 1021024"; "2026-02-24 | ROSSARI BIOTECH LIMITED | TO ORDER | HAZIRA PORT SURAT INHZA1, India | Chicago, UNITED STATES | 29094910 | BOL 9984737". Source counter: page claims 8,721 total shipments; 5 dated export rows actually rendered on the free view. Buyer-side rows also show Rossari as consignee/supplier to Bangladesh (Chattogram EPZ), Jordan, Bhutan, Egypt.
domestic_evidence: Screener.in consolidated financials (https://www.screener.in/company/ROSSARI/consolidated/): "Sales 2,396" (Mar 2026, Rs Cr) and "Sales 2,661" (TTM), with quarterly sales of Rs 697.56 Cr in the latest quarter; installed capacity "387,100 MTPA". Company site (https://www.rossari.com/) states "4,300+ products to 3,000+ customers across 65+ countries" and lists Indian customer testimonials (Hitech Hatch Fresh Pvt. Ltd., Diftech India, Valson Polyester Pvt. Ltd., Beepee Group) evidencing domestic supply relationships. Note: the annual report's explicit India-vs-export revenue split was not retrievable (rossari.com/investor-relations/annual-reports/ returned HTTP 404), so the domestic/export revenue ratio is null — not invented.
note: Legal entity exists and is listed (BSE: 543213, NSE: ROSSARI per Screener.in). Actual export shipments are confirmed by dated customs/B-L records with destination and HS codes — not merely website claims. Declared HS codes in the batch (110813, 290711, 290949, 291219) only partially match observed shipment HS codes: 29094910 (phenoxyethanol, CAS 122-99-6) matches the 290949 family, but observed shipments also include 34024900, 34013019 and 28362090 (soda ash), and no 110813/290711/291219 rows were seen in the free view. Per project rules this is not a rejection ground — company retained, HS set corrected to the factually observed codes (29094910, 34024900, 34013019, 28362090), verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Industry claim 'Food products and FMCG' is inaccurate: Rossari is a specialty chemicals manufacturer (textile, home & personal care, animal health). Revenue: Rs 2,396 Cr FY Mar-2026 consolidated (Screener.in); export volume in value terms is null (not public in free sources).
